name: Aniyome Chijoku no Time Sale ~Otto ni wa Ienai, Himitsu no Part~
original_name: 兄嫁・恥辱のタイムセール ～夫には言えない、秘密のパート～
source:
Suganami Fujio is a director known for his adult videos with good planning.
This time, his target is his sister-in-law, Suganami Tomoko, who works at a supermarket. Though younger than Fujio, she’s a stunning beauty—the perfect target.
Under the guise of filming a “documentary,” Fujio sneaks into Tomoko’s workplace and secures permission to shoot. While pretending to film a serious documentary, his camera is always focused on his sister-in-law.
Once the initial filming wraps up, Fujio calls Tomoko in for an “individual interview” during her break. He has her sit on a chair pre-equipped with a vibrator and begins the interview. Then, to slowly draw her into the throes of pleasure, Fujio flips the switch on the vibrator…

translation:
菅波藤夫是一名以策划周密的成人影片而闻名的导演。

这一次，他盯上了在超市工作的弟媳菅波朋子。她虽然比藤夫年轻，却是个令人惊艳的美人，正是理想的目标。

藤夫以拍摄“纪录片”为名潜入朋子的工作场所，取得了拍摄许可。表面上是在拍摄严肃的纪录片，他的镜头却始终对准弟媳。

第一轮拍摄结束后，藤夫趁休息时间把朋子叫来进行“单独采访”。他让朋子坐到预先装有跳蛋的椅子上，开始提问。为了让她逐渐沉溺于快感，藤夫按下了跳蛋的开关……
